Old code verified removed: no 'data:audio/wav;base64' and no local wakeDetector in /app/js/voice-chat.js. Regressions OK: aris9Voice.startContinuousRecord & createWakeWordDetector present, drawer opens with focus on drawer-btn-terminal, ESC closes drawer and restores focus to mobile-menu-btn, mode-always toggles pref, showNotification creates toast, terminal input (bottom 711) does not overlap taskbar (top 759) at 390x844. No console errors observed.

ui_bugs.issue: Infinite wakePulse animation includes transform: scale(), so the element is never 'stable' for Playwright/automation — a normal page.click() times out (30s) and force=True is required. Real users can still click it, but this breaks automated click testing and can cause sub-pixel jitter. Suggest animating only opacity/box-shadow (keep scale out) or wrap the dot in a static clickable span.

Clickable but not keyboard accessible: it is a <span role="status"> with a click handler, no tabindex, no role=button, no Enter/Space handling. Screen-reader/keyboard users cannot use it to open voice mode.

issues: Red dot renders correctly left of the title, no overlap with hamburger; at 390px it sits at x=60 with title starting at x=78 — spacing is tight but acceptable.

action_items: Optional: remove transform: scale() from @keyframes wakePulse (or add a static wrapper) so the indicator is automation-clickable without force.
Optional a11y: give #wake-indicator role=button + tabindex=0 + keydown(Enter/Space) handler.
critical_code_review_comments: aris9Wake.start() called directly (not through prefs) turns the detector on and shows the indicator but does not persist wakeWordEnabled=true, so a reload silently drops the state. Consider having start() set the pref (or document that prefs are the only entry point).

aris9Wake.start() early-returns when this._detector is truthy; if the underlying SpeechRecognition dies silently the object stays non-null and start() becomes a no-op — consider re-checking _detector.isActive() before returning.
Failure path in start() calls aris9Prefs.set('wakeWordEnabled', false), which re-enters the aris9:pref-changed listener -> stop(); it is safe today but the recursive pref/event coupling is fragile.

IMPORTANT: #mobile-menu-btn (hamburger) and the drawer are only rendered/visible at <=768px width, so run drawer tests at viewport 768x1024 or 390x844 — clicking [data-testid=mobile-menu-btn] or [data-testid=mode-wake] at 1920px times out (element not visible). Clicking [data-testid=wake-indicator] requires force=True because of the scale animation. Wake auto-start after reload needs ~1.5-2.5s wait (setTimeout 800ms on load). Real audio/STT flows were intentionally not exercised.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no functional defects found. The only test-blocking behaviour (indicator click timeout) is caused by the CSS transform scale in @keyframes wakePulse, which keeps the element's bounding box moving so Playwright's actionability 'stable' check never passes.
